turns.text: ok be honest. is it dumb to ask for more hours at the senior lunch instead of just telling andre the propane bill is high this month
Not dumb, but there are two separate questions here: can you cover the bill with more hours, and is it worth keeping it from him? Can you tell me roughly how much the bill is and what you earn now?

i work saturdays at the senior lunch 8 to 1 and my last shift was $90 lol. so thats like 5 hrs. the bill is bigger than one saturday for sure. i dont want him stressing, hes already doing all this overtime

Got it. At $90 a shift, one extra shift a week would add about $360 a month, assuming the center has the hours. If the bill is more than that, you'd need a second source or a payment plan with the propane company, which also doesn't have to involve anyone else.

Practical steps: 1) ask the center whether any weekday lunch shifts are open, 2) call the propane company about a budget plan, 3) decide whether you can hold the studying schedule with the extra hours.

ok bet. i skipped church today to batch cook red beans and rice so im already behind lol. andre fell asleep during the football game again after his overtime so hes wiped. and deshawn needs money for basketball soon too 🙏

That's a lot stacked up. Since basketball costs are coming too, it helps to add up the bill, the basketball fees and what extra shifts would bring in, so you know the real gap before you ask the center for anything.

Want me to draft a short message to the center asking about extra hours? I'll leave placeholders for your availability.

Hi [name of coordinator], this is [your name]. I work the Saturday lunch shift and would like to pick up more hours if any are available. I'm free [your availability]. Please let me know what's open. Thank you!
